group: Normal operation – typical reference resolution

input.value: JsonSchema instance with default config, id="parent", recursiveAnchor=false, validationContext having metaSchema=MetaSchema.V4, config=SchemaValidatorsConfig.DEFAULT

cases.expected: A non‑null JsonSchema object is returned. Its `getValidationContext()` contains the same meta‑schema and config as the parent schema, its `getEvaluationPath()` equals the supplied JsonNodePath, and its `getEvaluationParentSchema()` equals the supplied parent schema. No exception is thrown.
cases.description: Verifies that fromRef creates a new schema with the evaluation path and parent schema correctly propagated when all inputs are valid.

group: Parent schema with recursive anchor enabled

input.value: JsonSchema instance where `recursiveAnchor` is true (set via `setRecursiveAnchor(true)`) and other fields default

cases.expected: Returned JsonSchema has `isRecursiveAnchor()` equal to true (inherited from the parent). All other fields are identical to the normal case. No exception is thrown.
cases.description: Ensures that the recursive‑anchor flag is copied from the parent schema into the newly created schema.

group: Null evaluation path – fallback handling

input.value: Valid JsonSchema instance with default configuration

cases.expected: Returned JsonSchema has a `null` evaluation path (or the constructor substitutes `JsonNodePath.empty()` – whichever the implementation does). No NullPointerException is thrown.
cases.description: Checks that passing a null JsonNodePath does not cause a failure and the new schema is still created.

group: Null parent schema – defensive error handling

cases.expected: Throws NullPointerException (or IllegalArgumentException if the method validates arguments) because the method dereferences `refEvaluationParentSchema.validationContext`.
cases.description: Validates that the method does not silently accept a null parent schema and fails fast.

group: Parent schema with custom ValidationContext configuration

input.value: JsonSchema instance whose ValidationContext has a custom `SchemaValidatorsConfig` (e.g., `typeLoose = true`) and a non‑empty `schemaReferences` map

cases.expected: Returned JsonSchema’s ValidationContext contains the same custom config and the same schemaReferences map as the parent. All other fields are correctly propagated.
cases.description: Ensures that complex objects inside ValidationContext (config, references, resources, dynamic anchors) are copied correctly.

group: Parent schema with suppressed sub‑schema retrieval flag set

cases.expected: Returned JsonSchema has `suppressSubSchemaRetrieval` set to true (inherited from the parent). No exception is thrown.
cases.description: Verifies that the boolean flag controlling sub‑schema retrieval is propagated to the new schema.

group: Id propagation – parent schema id retained

input.value: JsonSchema instance with id="parent-schema-id", default config, validationContext non‑null

cases.expected: Returned JsonSchema is non‑null and its getId() equals "parent-schema-id". No exception is thrown.
cases.description: Ensures that the identifier of the parent schema is copied to the schema created by fromRef.

group: Dynamic anchors propagation

input.value: JsonSchema instance whose ValidationContext contains a dynamicAnchors map with entry {"myAnchor" -> some JsonSchema}

cases.expected: Returned JsonSchema’s ValidationContext.getDynamicAnchors() contains the same entry {"myAnchor" -> same JsonSchema object}. No exception is thrown.
cases.description: Verifies that dynamic anchors stored in the parent’s ValidationContext are correctly copied to the new schema.

group: Schema resources map propagation

input.value: JsonSchema instance whose ValidationContext has a non‑empty schemaResources map (e.g., {"http://example.com/schema" -> JsonNode})

cases.expected: Returned JsonSchema’s ValidationContext.getSchemaResources() is the same map instance (or contains the same entries). No exception is thrown.
cases.description: Checks that schema resource references are propagated unchanged.

group: Evaluation path with URL‑encoded characters

input.value: Valid JsonSchema instance with default configuration

cases.expected: Returned JsonSchema’s getEvaluationPath() equals the supplied JsonNodePath (the encoded segment is preserved). No exception is thrown.
cases.description: Ensures that fromRef does not attempt to decode or otherwise alter an already URL‑encoded path.

group: Root evaluation path – empty JsonNodePath

input.value: Valid JsonSchema instance with default configuration

cases.expected: Returned JsonSchema’s evaluationPath is empty (represents the root of the schema). No exception is thrown.
cases.description: Validates handling of a reference that points to the root of the schema.

group: Parent schema with null ValidationContext – defensive error handling

input.value: JsonSchema instance whose internal validationContext field is deliberately set to null

cases.expected: Method throws NullPointerException (or IllegalArgumentException) because it dereferences parentSchema.validationContext.
cases.description: Confirms that the method fails fast when the parent schema lacks a ValidationContext.

group: Returned schema is a distinct instance

input.value: JsonSchema instance with id="parent", default config

cases.expected: The object returned by fromRef is not the same reference as refEvaluationParentSchema (reference inequality). No exception is thrown.
cases.description: Ensures that fromRef creates a new JsonSchema object rather than returning the parent.

group: Validators list remains null until explicit initialization

input.value: Valid JsonSchema instance with default configuration

cases.expected: Immediately after fromRef, calling getValidators() on the returned schema returns null (or an empty list) because validators are not loaded yet. No exception is thrown.
cases.description: Verifies that the internal validators collection is not pre‑populated; it will be loaded later via initializeValidators().

group: Null config in parent ValidationContext – defensive error handling

input.value: JsonSchema instance whose internal ValidationContext has `config = null` (all other fields non‑null)

cases.expected: Throws NullPointerException (or IllegalArgumentException if ValidationContext constructor validates) because `refEvaluationParentSchema.getValidationContext().getConfig()` is null and is dereferenced while constructing the new ValidationContext.
cases.description: Ensures that a missing SchemaValidatorsConfig in the parent’s ValidationContext is detected and the method fails fast.

group: Null schemaReferences map in parent ValidationContext – defensive error handling

input.value: JsonSchema instance whose internal ValidationContext has `schemaReferences = null` (other fields valid)

cases.expected: Throws NullPointerException (or IllegalArgumentException) because the constructor of ValidationContext receives a null `schemaReferences` map.
cases.description: Verifies that the method does not silently accept a null map of schema references and throws an exception.

group: Null schemaResources map in parent ValidationContext – defensive error handling

input.value: JsonSchema instance whose internal ValidationContext has `schemaResources = null` (other fields valid)

cases.expected: Throws NullPointerException (or IllegalArgumentException) because a null `schemaResources` map is passed to the new ValidationContext.
cases.description: Confirms that missing schema resource mappings cause a failure rather than being silently ignored.

group: Null dynamicAnchors map in parent ValidationContext – defensive error handling

input.value: JsonSchema instance whose internal ValidationContext has `dynamicAnchors = null` (other fields valid)

cases.expected: Throws NullPointerException (or IllegalArgumentException) because the ValidationContext constructor receives a null `dynamicAnchors` map.
cases.description: Ensures that the method validates the presence of the dynamic anchors collection.

group: Null meta‑schema in parent ValidationContext – defensive error handling

input.value: JsonSchema instance whose internal ValidationContext has `metaSchema = null` (other fields valid)

cases.expected: Throws NullPointerException (or IllegalArgumentException) because a null meta‑schema is supplied to the new ValidationContext.
cases.description: Validates that the method does not accept a parent schema lacking a meta‑schema.

group: Null JsonSchemaFactory in parent ValidationContext – defensive error handling

input.value: JsonSchema instance whose internal ValidationContext has `jsonSchemaFactory = null` (other fields valid)

cases.expected: Throws NullPointerException (or IllegalArgumentException) because the ValidationContext constructor receives a null `jsonSchemaFactory`.
cases.description: Checks that the method fails fast when the factory required to create further schemas is missing.
